text: Voltooi die gesegde wat ons gebruik wanneer iemand met min middele ’n probleem oplos: “’n Boer maak ’n …”
gloss: Complete the saying used when someone solves a problem with little to hand: 'A farmer makes a …' — Plan: '’n Boer maak ’n plan', the classic Afrikaans saying for resourcefulness.

text: Wat op die etenstafel se naam lees van agter na voor presies dieselfde as van voor na agter?
gloss: Which thing on the dinner table has a name that reads the same backwards? — Lepel (spoon): l-e-p-e-l is a palindrome; vurk, bord, beker are not.

text: In Suid-Afrika val Kersfees in die somer. In watter seisoen val Paasfees, wat gewoonlik in Maart of April is?
gloss: In South Africa Christmas is in summer. In which season is Easter, usually in March or April? — Autumn: in the southern hemisphere March–May is autumn.

text: Watter Kaapse gereg is gekruide maalvleis wat met ’n eiervla bo-op in die oond gebak word en tradisioneel met geelrys en blatjang bedien word?
gloss: Which Cape dish is spiced mince baked with an egg custard on top, served with yellow rice and chutney? — Bobotie. Bredie is a stew, sosatie a kebab, frikkadel a meatball.

text: Op ’n gewone dobbelsteen tel die kolletjies op twee teenoorstaande kante altyd sewe. Hoeveel kolletjies is daar op die kant teenoor die twee?
gloss: On a normal die, opposite faces always add up to seven. How many pips are opposite the two? — 5, because 2 + 5 = 7.

text: Spinnekoppe is nie insekte nie, en ’n mens kan dit sommer aan hul bene sien. Hoeveel bene het ’n spinnekop?
gloss: Spiders aren't insects, and you can tell by their legs. How many legs does a spider have? — 8 (insects have 6).

text: Watter Nederlandse skilder het die “Sonneblomme”-reeks en “Die sterrenag” geskilder?
gloss: Which Dutch painter painted the Sunflowers series and The Starry Night? — Vincent van Gogh.

text: In watter animasierolprent leer ’n jong leeu die leuse “Hakuna Matata” by ’n meerkat en ’n vlakvark?
gloss: In which animated film does a young lion learn the motto 'Hakuna Matata' from a meerkat and a warthog? — The Lion King (Timon and Pumbaa).

text: Op watter openbare vakansiedag, 24 September, steek talle Suid-Afrikaners die vuur aan vir wat al bekend staan as Nasionale Braaidag?
gloss: On which public holiday, 24 September, do many South Africans light a fire for what's become known as National Braai Day? — Heritage Day (Erfenisdag). Freedom Day is 27 April, Youth Day 16 June, Day of Reconciliation 16 December.

text: As jy van Durban af reguit oos vaar, sal jy uiteindelik in Australië aankom. Oor watter oseaan vaar jy dan?
gloss: Sail due east from Durban and you reach Australia. Which ocean do you cross? — The Indian Ocean. The Southern Ocean lies far south, below 60°S.

text: Watter dier se Afrikaanse naam bestaan uit ’n metaal en ’n plaasdier?
gloss: Which animal's Afrikaans name is made of a metal and a farm animal? — Ystervark (porcupine): yster 'iron' + vark 'pig'. Seekoei = sea + cow (no metal), goudmol = gold + mole (not a farm animal), kameelperd = camel + horse.

text: Die sterk suidoostewind wat in die somer oor Kaapstad waai, vee volgens oorlewering die stad se rook en stof weg. Watter bynaam het hy daarom gekry?
gloss: The strong summer south-easter over Cape Town is said to sweep away the city's smoke and dust. What nickname did it get? — The Cape Doctor. The 'tablecloth' is the cloud it pushes over Table Mountain; the berg wind and the north-wester are other winds.

text: Watter rivier vorm die grens tussen Suid-Afrika en Namibië voordat dit in die Atlantiese Oseaan uitmond?
gloss: Which river forms the border between South Africa and Namibia before flowing into the Atlantic? — The Orange River. The Kunene also reaches the Atlantic but is Namibia's border with Angola.

text: Hoeveel punte kry ’n rugbyspan altesaam vir ’n drie wat suksesvol verdoel word?
gloss: How many points in total does a rugby team get for a try that is converted? — 7: a try is worth 5 and the conversion 2.

text: Die Griekse held wat net by sy hakskeen gewond kon word, het sy naam aan ’n sening agter die enkel gegee. Wie was hy?
gloss: The Greek hero who could only be wounded in the heel gave his name to a tendon behind the ankle. Who? — Achilles (the Achilles tendon, Afrikaans 'Achillespees').

text: Klank trek omtrent een kilometer in drie sekondes. Jy sien die weerlig en tel ses sekondes tot die donderslag. Hoe ver is die storm omtrent?
gloss: Sound travels about a kilometre in three seconds. You see lightning and count six seconds to the thunder. How far is the storm? — About 2 km: 6 ÷ 3. '6 km' traps those who count one second per kilometre.

text: Watter Franse skrywer het Phileas Fogg in tagtig dae om die wêreld laat reis?
gloss: Which French writer sent Phileas Fogg around the world in eighty days? — Jules Verne.

text: Watter speelgoedmaatskappy se naam is saamgetrek uit die Deense ‘leg godt’, wat ‘speel lekker’ beteken?
gloss: Which toy company's name is contracted from the Danish 'leg godt', 'play well'? — LEGO.

text: Een oktaaf hoër verdubbel ’n noot se frekwensie. Die A bo middel-C klink teen 440 Hz. Teen hoeveel hertz klink die A een oktaaf hoër?
gloss: One octave up doubles a note's frequency. The A above middle C is 440 Hz. What is the A one octave higher? — 880 Hz (1,760 Hz is two octaves up).

text: Suid-Afrika se nasionale voël pryk op die 5c-muntstuk. Watter voël is dit?
gloss: South Africa's national bird is on the 5c coin. Which bird? — The blue crane. The secretary bird is on the coat of arms (a trap).

text: Die Taalmonument staan op die hange van ’n berg langs die dorp waar die Genootskap van Regte Afrikaners in 1875 gestig is. Watter dorp?
gloss: The Afrikaans Language Monument stands on a mountain beside the town where the Society of True Afrikaners was founded in 1875. Which town? — Paarl.

text: Die Knysnabos is die wêreld van Saul Barnard in “Kringe in ’n bos” en van Benjamin in “Fiela se kind”. Wie het albei romans geskryf?
gloss: The Knysna forest is the world of Saul Barnard in 'Circles in a Forest' and of Benjamin in 'Fiela's Child'. Who wrote both? — Dalene Matthee.

text: Watter land grens aan Suid-Afrika, Namibië én Zimbabwe?
gloss: Which country borders South Africa, Namibia and Zimbabwe? — Botswana. Mozambique misses Namibia, Zambia misses South Africa, Lesotho borders only South Africa.

text: Baie Afrikaanse woorde het met slawe uit die Oos-Indiese eilande na die Kaap gekom. Watter vrugtenaam kom so uit Maleis?
gloss: Many Afrikaans words came to the Cape with slaves from the East Indies. Which fruit name comes from Malay that way? — Piesang (banana), from Malay 'pisang'. Apple, grape and pear are European fruits with Dutch names.

text: Hierdie metaal se Latynse naam, ‘plumbum’, gee dit die simbool Pb en Engels die woord ‘plumber’, want die Romeine het hul waterpype daarvan gemaak. Watter metaal?
gloss: This metal's Latin name 'plumbum' gives it the symbol Pb and English the word 'plumber', because the Romans made water pipes from it. Which metal? — Lead.

text: Op ’n ou hoeksteen is die jaartal in Romeinse syfers uitgekap: MCMLXI. Watter jaar is dit?
gloss: An old cornerstone has the year in Roman numerals: MCMLXI. Which year? — 1961: M 1000 + CM 900 + L 50 + X 10 + I 1.

text: Suid-Afrika is twee uur voor Greenwich-tyd, en Brittanje draai sy horlosies in die somer een uur vorentoe. Hoe laat is dit in Londen as dit 12:00 in Johannesburg is, middel Julie?
gloss: SA is two hours ahead of Greenwich time, and Britain puts its clocks forward an hour in summer. What time is it in London when it's 12:00 in Johannesburg in mid-July? — 11:00: 12:00 SAST = 10:00 GMT = 11:00 BST. 10:00 traps those who forget summer time.

text: Salvador Dalí se smeltende horlosies is ’n ikoon van watter kunsrigting?
gloss: Salvador Dalí's melting clocks are an icon of which art movement? — Surrealism.

text: Die QR-kode is in 1994 ontwerp om motoronderdele in fabrieke na te spoor. In watter land?
gloss: The QR code was designed in 1994 to track car parts in factories. In which country? — Japan, by Denso Wave, a Toyota group company.

text: Tussen watter twee stede hardloop atlete die Comrades-maraton, party jare ‘op’ en ander jare ‘af’?
gloss: Between which two cities is the Comrades Marathon run, some years 'up' and others 'down'? — Durban and Pietermaritzburg ('up' runs from Durban inland).

text: Wie het die epiese gedig “Raka” geskryf, oor ’n halfdierlike wese wat ’n vreedsame stam bedreig?
gloss: Who wrote the epic poem 'Raka', about a half-animal creature threatening a peaceful tribe? — N.P. van Wyk Louw (1941). W.E.G. Louw, also a poet, was his brother.

text: Die beroemde goue renostertjie is in 1933 in ’n graf op ’n heuwel in Limpopo gevind. By watter ou koninkryk se hoofstad?
gloss: The famous golden rhino was found in 1933 in a grave on a hill in Limpopo. At which old kingdom's capital? — Mapungubwe. Thulamela (also Limpopo) yielded gold too; Great Zimbabwe and Khami are its successors in Zimbabwe.

text: Chris Barnard het in 1967 die eerste hartoorplanting van mens tot mens uitgevoer. In watter Karoodorp is hy gebore?
gloss: Chris Barnard performed the first human-to-human heart transplant in 1967. In which Karoo town was he born? — Beaufort West (1922).

text: Watter Suid-Afrikaanse dier is, al sou ’n mens dit nooit raai nie, een van die olifant se naaste lewende familie?
gloss: Which South African animal is, unlikely as it seems, one of the elephant's closest living relatives? — The rock hyrax (dassie): hyraxes, sea cows and elephants form one group (Paenungulata). Rhino, hippo and warthog are far removed.

text: Op seevlak kook water by 100 °C. By watter temperatuur kook dit ongeveer in Johannesburg, sowat 1 750 m bo seevlak?
gloss: At sea level water boils at 100 °C. At about what temperature does it boil in Johannesburg, about 1,750 m up? — About 94 °C: lower air pressure lowers the boiling point, roughly 1 °C per 300 m. 85 °C would need about 4,500 m.

text: Kaapstad voel soos die suidpunt van die wêreld, maar hoe ver suid lê dit regtig? Watter stad lê die verste suid?
gloss: Cape Town feels like the bottom of the world, but how far south is it really? Which city lies furthest south? — Melbourne (about 37.8°S), against Buenos Aires 34.6°S, Cape Town 33.9°S and Sydney 33.9°S.

text: Watter Egiptiese god, met die kop van ’n jakkals, was die beskermer van balseming en van grafte?
gloss: Which jackal-headed Egyptian god protected embalming and tombs? — Anubis. Horus is falcon-headed, Thoth ibis-headed, Osiris shown as a mummified king.

text: Watter skaakstuk staan die hele spel lank op blokkies van dieselfde kleur?
gloss: Which chess piece stays on squares of the same colour all game? — The bishop (loper): it moves only diagonally, and diagonal steps never change colour. The knight always changes colour.

text: Watter Suid-Afrikaner het “District 9” geregisseer, die wetenskapfiksie-rolprent oor ruimtewesens wat in Johannesburg strand?
gloss: Which South African directed 'District 9', the science-fiction film about aliens stranded in Johannesburg? — Neill Blomkamp (2009). Gavin Hood made 'Tsotsi', Jamie Uys 'The Gods Must Be Crazy'.

text: September se naam kom van die Latynse ‘septem’, sewe, want dit was eens die sewende maand. Met watter maand het die oudste Romeinse jaar dan begin?
gloss: September comes from Latin 'septem', seven, because it was once the seventh month. So which month began the oldest Roman year? — March: count back six months from September. Martius was the first month of the early Roman calendar.

text: Die grootste bevestigde meteoriet-impakstruktuur op aarde is ’n Wêrelderfenisgebied in Suid-Afrika. Watter een?
gloss: The largest verified meteorite impact structure on Earth is a World Heritage Site in South Africa. Which? — The Vredefort Dome. Tswaing, Morokweng and Kalkkop are real but smaller South African impact sites.

text: Watter piek is die hoogste binne Suid-Afrika se grense?
gloss: Which peak is the highest within South Africa's borders? — Mafadi (about 3,450 m) in the Drakensberg. Thabana Ntlenyana is higher but lies in Lesotho.

text: Watter planeet wentel om die Son terwyl hy amper op sy sy lê, met ’n ashelling van byna 98°?
gloss: Which planet orbits the Sun almost lying on its side, with an axial tilt of nearly 98°? — Uranus. Venus is the trap: it spins backwards, but is nearly upright (tilt about 177°).

text: Wie het in 1822 met behulp van die Rosetta-steen aangekondig dat hy die Egiptiese hiërogliewe ontsyfer het?
gloss: Who announced in 1822, with the help of the Rosetta Stone, that he had deciphered Egyptian hieroglyphs? — Jean-François Champollion (Lettre à M. Dacier). Thomas Young made earlier partial progress.

text: Dante se “Goddelike Komedie” begin in die Hel en eindig in die Paradys. Waar speel die middelste deel af?
gloss: Dante's Divine Comedy begins in Hell and ends in Paradise. Where is the middle part set? — Purgatory (Purgatorio). Limbo is the first circle of Dante's Hell; Hades and Elysium are Greek.

text: In 1947 het tegnici ’n ‘bug’ in die Harvard Mark II-rekenaar opgespoor en dit in die logboek vasgeplak: ’n regte insek. Watter soort?
gloss: In 1947 technicians found a 'bug' in the Harvard Mark II and taped it into the logbook: a real insect. What kind? — A moth, logged as the 'first actual case of bug being found'.

text: In watter museum hang Rembrandt se reusagtige “Nagwag”?
gloss: In which museum does Rembrandt's huge 'Night Watch' hang? — The Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam. The Mauritshuis in The Hague is the trap (Vermeer's 'Girl with a Pearl Earring').

text: Roquefort, die bekende blouskimmelkaas, word in grotte in Suid-Frankryk laat ryp word. Van watter dier se melk word dit gemaak?
gloss: Roquefort, the famous blue cheese, is ripened in caves in southern France. Which animal's milk is it made from? — Sheep's (ewe's) milk, by law.

text: Koolstof-14 se halfleeftyd is sowat 5 730 jaar. Watter deel van die oorspronklike koolstof-14 in ’n stuk hout is ná sowat 17 190 jaar nog oor?
gloss: Carbon-14's half-life is about 5,730 years. What fraction of the original carbon-14 in a piece of wood remains after about 17,190 years? — An eighth: three half-lives, ½ × ½ × ½. 'A third' traps those who divide by three.

text: Engels het al vier hierdie woorde uit Suid-Afrika oorgeneem, maar net een het Afrikaans self uit Portugees gekry. Watter een?
gloss: English took all four words from South Africa, but only one came into Afrikaans from Portuguese. Which? — Kraal, from Portuguese 'curral' (compare Spanish 'corral'). Veld, trek and stoep are Dutch.
